about.title: About
about.introGaming: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> and gaming is my thing: I cut highlights, trailers and Instagram content with one goal, keeping viewers watching from the first second. I work on <hl>rhythm</hl>, sound and the moments that make the difference, because a good clip doesn't just show the game: it tells it.
about.introBrand: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> working with brands and creators to turn ideas and raw footage into clear, polished videos. I focus on <hl>social</hl> content and brand videos, with attention to visual consistency, pacing and message. My goal is for every video to sound like the brand behind it.
